
CREATE-TASK
Create a new task with minimal requirements for operational work (setup, config, infrastructure)

WHEN TO USE
  Use when tracking operational work that does not require user-facing features, tests, or acceptance criteria (e.g., setup CI/CD, update dependencies, refactor code).

PREREQUISITES
  • Prefix must be registered: fspec create-prefix PREFIX "Description"
  • Epic must exist if using --epic: fspec create-epic EPIC "Title"
  • Parent task must exist if using --parent

USAGE
  fspec create-task <prefix> <title> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <prefix> (required)
    Task prefix (e.g., TASK, INFRA, DEVOPS). Must be registered with create-prefix first.
  <title> (required)
    Brief description of the task

OPTIONS
  -d, --description <description>
    Detailed description of the task
  -e, --epic <epic>
    Epic ID to associate with this task
  -p, --parent <parent>
    Parent task ID for hierarchical relationships

TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  Create task: fspec create-task PREFIX "Title",Tasks can skip specifying phase (optional feature file),Move directly to implementing: fspec update-work-unit-status TASK-001 implementing,Complete work without tests (for operational tasks),Move to done: fspec update-work-unit-status TASK-001 done

EXAMPLES
  1. Create simple task with minimal requirements
  $ fspec create-task TASK "Setup CI/CD pipeline"
  ✓ Created task TASK-001
  Title: Setup CI/CD pipeline

<system-reminder>
Task TASK-001 created successfully.

Tasks are for operational work.
  - Tasks have optional feature file
  - Tasks have optional tests
  - Tasks can skip Example Mapping
</system-reminder>

  2. Create task with epic
  $ fspec create-task INFRA "Configure monitoring" --epic=infrastructure
  ✓ Created task INFRA-001
  Title: Configure monitoring
  Epic: infrastructure

  3. Create task with description
  $ fspec create-task DEVOPS "Update dependencies" --description="Security patches"
  ✓ Created task DEVOPS-001
  Title: Update dependencies
  Description: Security patches

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Prefix 'PREFIX' is not registered
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ Parent task 'PARENT-001' does not exist
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ Epic 'epic-name' does not exist
    Fix: undefined

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec fspec update-work-unit-status - Move task through workflow
  fspec fspec list-work-units - List all tasks
  fspec fspec show-work-unit - Show task details
  fspec fspec update-work-unit - Update task title/description

NOTES
  • Tasks have optional feature files (not required for operational work)
  • Tasks have optional tests (not required for infrastructure work)
  • Tasks can skip Example Mapping (no need for acceptance criteria)
  • Tasks can move directly to implementing without specifying phase
  • Examples: Setup CI/CD, configure monitoring, update dependencies, refactor code, write docs
